info.title: Delibird API
info.description: API for the Delibird wishlist app.

post.description: Ends the session this request was made with.
Emails a sign-in code and magic link. Answers the same way whether or not the account exists.

get.description: The devices signed in to this account. `current` marks the one making the request.

delete.description: Signs a device out of this account.

post.description: Exchanges a code (or a magic-link token) for a session token. The first sign-in creates the account.

get.description: Reports whether the API can reach its database and Redis.
One item. Sending another of your lists as `wishlist` moves the item to the end of that list.

patch.description: One item. Sending another of your lists as `wishlist` moves the item to the end of that list.

delete.description: One item. Sending another of your lists as `wishlist` moves the item to the end of that list.

put.description: Adds or replaces an item's picture (multipart upload), or removes it.

delete.description: Adds or replaces an item's picture (multipart upload), or removes it.

post.description:
Reserve an item on a list shared with you, or cancel your reservation. For anyone who can't
reserve the item, the owner included, the answer is the same 404 as for an item that doesn't exist.

delete.description:
Reserve an item on a list shared with you, or cancel your reservation. For anyone who can't
reserve the item, the owner included, the answer is the same 404 as for an item that doesn't exist.

get.description: The signed-in person's lists, default list included, in their chosen order.

post.description: The signed-in person's lists, default list included, in their chosen order.

get.description: One list with its items. The default list can be renamed but not deleted.

patch.description: One list with its items. The default list can be renamed but not deleted.

delete.description: One list with its items. The default list can be renamed but not deleted.

get.description: The items on one list, in order. New items go to the end.

post.description: The items on one list, in order. New items go to the end.
Sets the order of all the items on one list.

get.description: The people a list is shared with. Adding someone returns their personal link, once.

post.description: The people a list is shared with. Adding someone returns their personal link, once.
Sets the order of all the signed-in person's lists.

get.description: The signed-in account. Deleting it removes the account and everything that belongs to it.

patch.description: The signed-in account. Deleting it removes the account and everything that belongs to it.

delete.description: The signed-in account. Deleting it removes the account and everything that belongs to it.

get.description: Lists other people shared with you, once you accepted their link.
One list shared with you, with which items are free, yours, or taken and by whom.

A list opened through someone's link. Needs no account, and never says which items are taken:
signed-in viewers see that in "Shared with me". The owner gets the same owner-safe view.

post.description: Accepts a link: the list then appears under "Shared with me" and its items can be reserved.

403.description: Someone else already accepted this link

delete.description: Stops sharing with one person. Their link stops working.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB.
Absolute URL of the item's picture, if it has one.

NewShare.description: A share as its owner sees it.

joined.description: Whether someone has accepted the link.

joined_as.description: The name of whoever accepted the link.

link.description: The person's own link. It is shown only once.

NewShareRequest.description: A share as its owner sees it.

ids.description: Every id, in the new order.

by.description: Who is getting it, when someone else is.

Share.description: A share as its owner sees it.

joined.description: Whether someone has accepted the link.

joined_as.description: The name of whoever accepted the link.

SharedItem.description: An item as people the list is shared with see it, without anything about reservations.

SharedList.description: A list opened through a share link. `role` says how the requester relates to it.

role.description: owner: it's your list. viewer: you accepted this link. invited: sign in or accept to reserve. anonymous: not signed in.

VerifyRequest.description: Either the email and the six-digit code, or the token from the magic link.

ViewerItem.description: An item as a signed-in viewer sees it: with whether it is taken, and by whom.

item_count.description: How many items the list holds.

is_shared.description: Whether anyone has a link to this list.

item_count.description: How many items the list holds.

is_shared.description: Whether anyone has a link to this list.
